title: Pure infiniteness and primary factorisation
summary: We show that there is no real or complex indecomposable Banach space with the primary factorisation property (PFP). We relate the PFP of a Banach space $E$ to ring-theoretic infiniteness of $\mathcal{B}(E)$ and of $\mathcal{B}(E)/\mathcal{M}_E$, where $\mathcal{M}_E$ denotes the set of operators not factoring the identity on $E$, in the case it is the unique maximal ideal of $\mathcal{B}(E)$.
